cal: UEE Navy/military-focused. Military ships (Aegis, Anvil combat hulls, Gladius/Hornet/Vanguard lines, etc.) frequently get free-fly access and are on standard sale; occasional limited paint/variant drops.

The biggest ship-sale event of the year. Nearly every manufacturer gets a dedicated day with sales, and this is when most Limited/Concept ships (new hull reveals, rare variants) become available to pledge - often the ONLY time in the year for certain paints or special editions.
Sale window tied to the game's anniversary and (in CitizenCon years) the convention itself. New concept ship reveals commonly happen here.
Winter holiday sale, storewide discounts, some limited holiday-themed paints.
Alien Week / Xenothreat / other mid-year events
Smaller, shorter sale windows tied to lore events or specific alien-manufacturer ships (Aopoa, Esperia, Banu).
devnote: Development Progress CitizenCon (the big annual in-person fan event CIG normally holds in October/November) is NOT happening in 2026 - multiple community sources confirm it was called off for this year. This does not affect the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo (IAE), which is a separate in-game/sale event and is still expected in November 2026 per the community roadmap (that's the 'Est. IAE 2026' note in the Development Progress tab). CIG has not tied the Kraken's release to CitizenCon specifically - its production timeline runs independent of the event calendar, so its lack this year doesn't change the Kraken estimate above.
